intro: Proposals for you to choose from. Nothing on this page has been implemented. Reply with the ID and option letter (for example 'S-01: B') and the change will be made in a later session.

suggestions.topic: Outbound link policy until Special Link validation

options.text: Keep the five submitted short links as they are, marked sponsored, with the flags shown.
options.tradeoff: Buyers can click now. Compliance (F-02, F-03) stays open.

options.text: Hide the buy buttons until the single-link test passes (F-09). Show product details only.
options.tradeoff: No outbound clicks during the test. Lowest compliance risk.

options.text: Replace the short links with Special Links generated in Associates Central after a passing test.
options.tradeoff: Requires the test and an Associates account login.

suggestions.recommendation: B now, then C if the test passes. A only if you accept the open compliance risk.

options.text: No site analytics. Use Associates reports only.
options.tradeoff: Nothing is installed. No click data on the site.

options.text: Self-hosted privacy-friendly analytics and a click endpoint on a server you control.
options.tradeoff: Data stays with you. Needs a server (outside GitHub Pages) and maintenance.

options.text: A hosted privacy-focused analytics service with an outbound-click event.
options.tradeoff: Fast to set up. A third-party processor needs a data agreement.

suggestions.recommendation: B if the data must stay with you; C if speed matters more. Either needs a host choice first.

suggestions.topic: Five events to record (proposal, not adopted)

options.text: page_view: a reader loads a page. Counts only; no identifiers stored.
options.tradeoff: Basic traffic signal.

options.text: product_view: a product card is shown on screen.
options.tradeoff: Shows which products are seen.

options.text: outbound_click: a sponsored link is clicked. Records product ID and link ID only.
options.tradeoff: The core measure for the Amazon program.

options.text: guide_read_50: a reader scrolls past 50% of a guide.
options.tradeoff: Measures engagement with guides.

options.text: feed_subscribe: a reader opens the RSS feed.
options.tradeoff: Measures interest in new guides.

suggestions.recommendation: Adopt all five only after the owner confirms the list (Q-09). Keep the set to these names unless the owner changes it.

options.text: One guide per week.
options.tradeoff: Fastest learning; higher workload; thinner pages risk.

options.text: One guide every two weeks, with a review after eight weeks.
options.tradeoff: Enough time for sourcing; slower signal.

options.text: One guide per month.
options.tradeoff: Lowest workload; slowest learning.

suggestions.recommendation: B, with a measurement review before choosing the next topic.

options.text: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
options.tradeoff: Matches P-01 to P-03 and P-02 in form.

options.text: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
options.tradeoff: Uses only listed capacities, which must be sourced.

options.text: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
options.tradeoff: Needs dimensions and care instructions, which are not yet captured.

options.text: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
options.tradeoff: Broad; covers the oven-style products.

suggestions.recommendation: A, then B. Both need only data that can be captured from product pages. The four titles are working titles, not claims about popularity or quality.

options.text: Owner supplies original photos of the products.
options.tradeoff: Best for trust; needs the owner's time.

options.text: No product images. Typographic cards (current).
options.tradeoff: No licence risk. Less visual appeal.

options.text: Labelled illustrations that are not product photos.
options.tradeoff: Looks fuller; must not imply a product depiction.

suggestions.recommendation: B now. Move to A once the IP licence (Q-14) is read.

suggestions.topic: Dated data for niche and trend research

options.text: Weekly dated capture of public Amazon Best Sellers pages for these categories, with source and date on each row.
options.tradeoff: Free; manual unless automated within terms.

options.text: Product Advertising API data, once the account is eligible.
options.tradeoff: Official; depends on the owner's Associates account status (Q-18).

options.text: A third-party research tool.
options.tradeoff: Fast; its data needs its own licence check. Not reviewed.

suggestions.recommendation: A now; B once eligible. No trend or conversion claim until dated data exists.

options.text: amazon.com only (current listings).
options.tradeoff: Matches the supplied links.

options.text: Netherlands marketplace listings, if the tracking ID is for that marketplace.
options.tradeoff: Matches the owner's location; needs new links.

options.text: Owner verifies the site in Google Search Console and submits the sitemap.
options.tradeoff: Manual step; gives real search data.

options.text: Add a reader email capture through a third-party form.
options.tradeoff: Needs a consent flow and a data agreement.

suggestions.recommendation: A now (the sitemap and feed already exist). B later, once consent is set up.

options.text: Keep the working name 'WinC Kitchen Picks'.
options.tradeoff: No change.

options.text: Owner supplies a name and domain.
options.tradeoff: Needs a domain and a change to every page.

suggestions.recommendation: B when a name is chosen. A until then.
